company.name: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi
company.shortDescription: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi, provides agentic AI solutions that harmonize workflows, empower teams, and unleash enterprise potential.
company.description:
Leah, formerly ContractPodAi, empowers enterprises to build, orchestrate, and govern intelligent AI agents across legal, procurement, finance, and beyond through Leah Agentic OS and Leah Agentic CLM  (Contract Lifecycle Management). 

Founded on elevating human judgment rather than replacing it, Leah automates complex workflows, connects data silos, and drives measurable ROI at scale. 

Our foundation rests on four pillars:  

Lead - Always one step ahead, bringing customers along with us.  

Empower - Built to help employees do their very best work.  

Accelerate - Streamlines and accelerates your enterprise's most desirable outcomes.  

Harmonize - Evolves to bring people and processes into perfect harmony. 

Trusted by global enterprises, Leah delivers competitive advantage through AI-driven automation and operational excellence. Partnerships with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Cohere, and Mistral strengthen our technological foundation. 

With offices in London, New York, Dubai, Sydney, Glasgow, Mumbai, and Singapore, Leah continues expanding globally.
